item.title: New Head of Academy Coach Development appointed
item.description: We are pleased to welcome a new member to the team within the Walsall FC Academy, with Michael Flannery joining us as our new Head of Academy Coach Development. Michael, who undertook an Hons BSc in Football Business & Coaching followed by a MSc in Coaching & Analysis, has an extensive background in football with over 15 years of coaching experience, with his most recent role at Accrington Stanley as their Head of Academy Coach & Player Development. item.title: Willis analyses defeat against Lichfield City
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis insisted that his side’s 2-0 defeat to Lichfield City Women was down to lapses of concentration in the second half. item.description: Walsall suffered a frustrating 1-0 loss to Fleetwood Town at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium on Tuesday night. item.title: Mat Sadler shares his frustration with Fleetwood defeat
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler was left frustrated with the nature of last night's defeat to Fleetwood as a first half goal for the Cod Army saw the Saddlers condemned to six without a win on home soil. Sadler was pleased with the performance of the squad but explained how things needed to improve in the final third. "Difficult one to take because we didn't deserve to lose," Sadler said. item.title: Harrison Burke & Aaron Pressley visit Blue Coat C.E. Academy with Walsall FC Foundation
item.description: Students at Blue Coat C.E. Academy were delighted to welcome Saddlers players Harrison Burke and Aaron Pressley last week. The players spent time with students taking part in Assist 2 Achieve and Cyrille Regis Legacy Trust sessions – initiatives designed to support young people during a crucial period of development in their life, both inside and outside of the classroom.
